title: Real-Time Resume Reviews | LinkedIn Live Stream w/ Dave Fano
description:
The job of your resume is to get you an interview—and we want to help you craft the most compelling resume possible to help you get a foot in the door. 

In this LinkedIn Live, Dave Fano breaks down a few submitted resumes in what we hope will be the first of many live reviews.

What other questions do you have about your resume? Let us know in the comments.
